note: COMPLETE means implemented end to end and verified by unit/integration/live-Paper tests. Anything a person must look at in a real Minecraft client is MANUAL_QA_REQUIRED. No subsystem is a scaffold or placeholder.

node fields requiredQuest / requiredAchi.reason: no achievement system exists; quest/item/resource gates need game hooks that are not there. requires (node ranks) and level are implemented.

skill point economy (level, story chapte.evidence: SkillTreeTest.pointsFollowProgression, SkillEngineTest, live 0 pts at level 1 / 44 at 60

skill points from dungeons / bosses / ac.reason: no per-dungeon first-clear or achievement record to derive them from

persistence (V10 skill_data, JSON docume.evidence: JdbcSkillStateIT on PostgreSQL, live restart test

migration support.evidence: SchemaMigrator V10 (MySQL + PostgreSQL scripts); data-level: unknown ids dropped and refunded (SkillEngineTest.normalise...)

passive stat effects (health, speed, arm.reason: attribute stats verified live (max health, rejoin); combat/EXP/loot/dodge/thorns/lifesteal paths are compiled and code-reviewed but not individually measured in a live fight

passive spells (procs: 8 triggers, 14 ki.reason: LOW_HP shield path and dispatcher verified live via /skillsadmin fire; the other kinds are code only

spell modifiers (14 keys on the 20 spell.reason: spells cast live with modifiers learned and no errors; the numeric effect of each modifier was not measured

keystones (5).reason: learned and attribute side (Тэнгэртэй Холбогдох max HP, Талын Салхи walking speed) verified live; low-HP resistance, single-arrow, durability and horse-speed paths are code only

active abilities: 20 class spells (exist.evidence: all five classes cast their ultimate live (effects, cooldown message, HUD), spells cast live

per-spell cooldowns.reason: base spells are gated by the class resource and a 400 ms anti-spam gap, as before; only ultimates (45 s) have cooldowns

interactive map (zoom, pan, states, tool.reason: every slot, state, connector model, button and message verified live through the inventory protocol; how it looks and feels in the game client has not been seen by a person

class filtering in the map.reason: the map always shows the player's own class; there is a category filter instead

resource pack assets (background, 16 con.reason: generated deterministically, pass the pack validator and budget; not seen in a client. Pack hash is SHA-1 as the Minecraft protocol requires; SHA-256 is not used.

Gemini art for the skill tree.reason: not needed: the map assets are procedural pixel art; no Gemini call was made for this feature

HUD (points row, ultimate cooldown, buil.reason: action-bar points and ultimate state verified live; sidebar points row and the active build/keystone on the HUD are in the info panel and /skills info only

commands /skills /skill /skillsadmin (+.evidence: live: info, build, search, skill, admin inspect/grantpoints/unlock/reset/orb/fire/reload/validate

Orb of Oblivion item + recipe.evidence: live: admin gives, right click, confirm, refund, consumed. Crafting recipe registered (not crafted by a bot).

listeners.reason: only the events the system needs: join, quit, respawn, damage, damage-by-entity, death, sneak, regain health, item damage, mount, swap hands, interact, chat (search), inventory clicks via the existing menu listener. PlayerMove, ProjectileHit/Launch, BlockBreak, command preprocess, dungeon/quest events are deliberately not used.
